comment:
## Automated AI review

> **Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

Follow-up to the earlier reviews ([first](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/pull/12669#issuecomment-5789259111), [second](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/pull/12669#issuecomment-5803956392)) and the [author reply](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/pull/12669#issuecomment-5803984300), checked at `f9c706e3`.

| Earlier finding | Status at `f9c706e3` |
|---|---|
| Budget counts characters, not bytes, in a UTF-8 locale | **Resolved** |
| Names with escaped or invalid UTF-8 bytes exceed the limit after awk | **Still present**, only when such bytes make up a large share of the listing |
| 500-file cap is not a byte limit | **Still present, narrower**: now only through the row above |
| Only the newest 500 **or fewer** files are eligible | **Addressed** in the PR description |
| Test expected `$real/clip.webm` | Resolved earlier; test unchanged |

**Verified:** `LC_ALL=C awk` makes `length()` count bytes. In isolated runs with the real `omarchy-menu-file` and `omarchy-menu-select`, long CJK and Cyrillic names that fail at `bad95f00` with `Argument list too long` now open the picker (about 200 to 285 entries depending on name length, payload about 80.5 KB). For valid UTF-8 names without heavy escaping, the 80,000-byte budget keeps the payload at or below about 81.2 KB, well under the 131,071-byte single-argument limit. The exit status still comes from `omarchy-menu-select`, and the PR's test passes at this head. No regressions were found in the changed lines or in `omarchy-transcode` and `omarchy-games-retro-install`.

## Escaped and invalid UTF-8 bytes still grow past the limit

The awk budget counts raw path bytes, but `omarchy-menu-select` expands some bytes when it JSON-encodes the options:

```text
byte in path                            bytes in payload
valid UTF-8 (including CJK, Cyrillic)   1 -> 1
" \ tab CR                              1 -> 2
other control bytes (0x01 to 0x1f)      1 -> 6   (\u00XX)
invalid UTF-8 (e.g. CP1251, Latin-1)    1 -> 3   (U+FFFD)
```

With a full budget, the payload passes 131,071 bytes when roughly more than 31% of listed path bytes are invalid UTF-8, more than 12.5% are control bytes, or more than 62% are quotes or backslashes. Isolated runs at `f9c706e3` with synthetic file names:

```text
case                                        payload (bytes)  result
long CP1251 names (56% non-UTF-8 bytes)         158,670      Argument list too long (exit 126)
ASCII names inside a CP1251-named folder        172,368      Argument list too long (exit 126)
names with 40 control bytes each                174,670      Argument list too long (exit 126)
names with 120 quotes/backslashes each          137,813      Argument list too long (exit 126)
shorter CP1251 names (27% non-UTF-8 bytes)       62,170      opens
Latin-1 accented names                           71,170      opens
```

**Impact:** Collections with long legacy-encoded names (for example folders copied from older CP1251 or Latin-1 systems), or with unusual characters, still make `omarchy-transcode` exit without a picker and `omarchy-games-retro-install` exit silently. Ordinary UTF-8 libraries are no longer affected. The new code comment ("headroom for JSON quotes/escapes") and the PR description ("cannot blow MAX_ARG_STRLEN") state slightly more than this.

**Suggested change:** The encoded-size check inside `omarchy-menu-select` proposed in the reply covers all of these cases, because the exact JSON and metadata are known only there. If that check is left for a separate PR, narrowing the code comment to valid UTF-8 names keeps it accurate.

---

## Review information

**Test scope:** Follow-up at `f9c706e3`, compared with `bad95f00`. Isolated command-only runs used the real `omarchy-menu-file` and `omarchy-menu-select`, synthetic file names and a stub in place of the shell IPC hop. Payload sizes for failing rows were computed with the real Perl encoders on the exact listing, a method that matched the stub-observed size in every run that opened. The PR's test file ran by itself. Menu rendering, the real IPC transport and the full test suite were not run. Limits assume 4 KiB pages and the `C.UTF-8` locale. How common legacy-encoded names are in practice was not assessed.

**AI process:** Opus 5.5 Medium coordination and synthesis, independent Opus 5.5 Xhigh and GPT 6 Sol Xhigh technical assessments, Opus 5.5 Medium editorial check.

**Opt out:** To stop receiving these reviews, reply to this comment saying so.
